audience: Brazilian businesses that run sales, stock, invoicing and finance in Maqplan ERP

useCases.title: Review sales orders and invoices with their customer
useCases.text: List the sales orders and the invoices of the ERP. Open one sales order and one customer to read the full details.

useCases.title: Check stock before you promise a delivery
useCases.text: Find the product in the product list, then list the stock balances to see what is in stock.

useCases.title: Read the electronic invoices (NF-e) of the company
useCases.text: List the NF-e documents and open one to read all its fields. List the fiscal operation natures for reference.

useCases.title: Review financial entries against the chart of accounts
useCases.text: List the financial entries and open one to read its fields. List the chart of accounts and the payment methods for reference.

useCases.title: Review branches and sellers of the ERP company
useCases.text: Read the company of the API key, then list its branches and sellers. Open one branch to read all its fields.
